error.bluetooth_unavailable: Home Assistant can't use a Bluetooth adapter on this device, or it can only reach the robot through a Bluetooth proxy. error.bond_reset_failed: Home Assistant could not remove the saved pairing. Close this dialog, check the Bluetooth adapter and Settings > System > Logs, then start setup again.

error.certificate_changed: This robot no longer matches the one Home Assistant was set up with, so nothing was changed. If it was reset, close this dialog, then go to Settings > Devices & services > Matic (Unofficial) > the entry's ⋮ menu > Reconfigure > Robot was reset.
error.different_robot: A different robot answered at this address, so nothing was changed. If your robot moved, enter its new address under Robot address; a replacement robot is added as a new robot.
error.invalid_certificate: Home Assistant can't confirm this is your robot, so it did not connect. Check that the address belongs to your robot, then try again.
error.invalid_credential: The robot did not accept Home Assistant's saved pairing. Pair again to replace it.
error.invalid_passkey: Enter all six digits shown on the robot's screen.
error.multiple_robots_nearby: Home Assistant can see more than one robot over Bluetooth and can't tell which one to pair, so nothing was changed. Turn Pairing mode off on your other robots, wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.pairing_code_expired: That code expired. In the Matic app, turn Pairing mode off and back on, then choose Start pairing and enter the new code right away.
error.pairing_code_rejected: The robot did not accept that code. In the Matic app, turn Pairing mode off and back on, then choose Start pairing and enter the new code right away.

error.pairing_timeout: Pairing did not finish within 5 minutes. Keep the robot near the adapter with Pairing mode on in the Matic app, then try again.
error.recover_cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach a robot at this address. Check that it is on and on the same network, or enter the right address under Robot address.
error.recover_credential_rejected: The robot did not accept the pairing it just issued. Turn Pairing mode off and back on in the Matic app, then choose Start pairing again.

discovery_failed.title: No robot found
discovery_failed.description: Check that the robot is on and on the same network as Home Assistant, and that this Home Assistant has a Bluetooth adapter. Pairing needs one.

select_robot.title: Choose your robot
select_robot.description: More than one robot was found. Pick the one to add.

manual.title: Enter the robot's address
manual.description: Home Assistant checks that this is your robot before it saves anything.

pair.title: Connect your robot
pair.description:
Pairing mode is a short window in the Matic app that lets Home Assistant connect to the robot over Bluetooth. Put Home Assistant's Bluetooth adapter within a few feet of the robot, then:

1. In the Matic app, go to Settings > Connectivity > Add another user.
2. Turn on Pairing mode.
3. Come back here and choose Start pairing.

reset_bond.title: Remove the robot's saved pairing?
reset_bond.description: Home Assistant reused an earlier Bluetooth pairing that the robot rejected. Removing it from this device pairs again with a new six-digit code, so turn on Pairing mode in the Matic app first and close this dialog if you can't tell which robot to choose.

pairing_code.title: Enter the robot's code
pairing_code.description: Type the six-digit code from the robot's screen now. It expires after about 20 seconds.

data_description.passkey: Home Assistant never saves the code.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair Home Assistant again
reauth_confirm.description:
Home Assistant can no longer connect to the robot, so it needs a new pairing that replaces the saved one. Put the adapter within a few feet of the robot, then:

1. In the Matic app, go to Settings > Connectivity > Add another user.
2. Turn on Pairing mode.
3. Come back here and choose Start pairing.

reconfigure.title: Change robot connection
reconfigure.description: Choose what to update without removing the robot.

update_address.title: Update robot address
update_address.description: Home Assistant checks that this is the same robot before it saves the new address.

recover_identity.title: Pair {name} again
recover_identity.description:
Use this only if {name} was reset: a replacement robot is added as a new robot, and plans do not move to it. Put the adapter within a few feet of the robot, then:

1. In the Matic app, go to Settings > Connectivity > Add another user.
2. Turn on Pairing mode.
3. Come back here and choose Start pairing.

robot_stop_pending.message: The robot is stopping. Wait until it docks, then try again.

robot_command_failed.message: The robot couldn't do that. Check the robot, then try again.

room_interrupted.message: Cleaning in {room} stopped before the robot confirmed it was done, so the room stays due for the next run. Check the robot, then start the plan again.

room_taken_over.message: Home Assistant could no longer confirm that the cleaning in {room} was the one it started, so the plan stopped. Check the robot, then start the plan again.

room_plan_unavailable.message: Home Assistant doesn't have the robot's room map right now. Check that the robot is online and has a current map, then try again.

rooms_must_be_list.message: Rooms must be a list of room names or IDs.

unknown_rooms.message: These rooms aren't on the robot's map: {rooms}. Check the spelling, or choose rooms from the list.

room_sequence_limit.message: A clean can include up to {limit} rooms. Remove some rooms and try again.

unknown_plan.message: No saved plan matches {plan}. Check the name, or choose from your saved plans.

unknown_area.message: No custom area matches {area}. Check the name, or choose from your custom areas.

unsupported_command.message: That Matic command is not supported. Use start, clean_all, clean_rooms, clean_segments, pause, resume, stop, dock, or return_home.

managed_run_changed.message: The cleaning plan changed before Stop could be sent, so Stop was not sent. Check the robot and press Stop again if it is still cleaning.

ambiguous_room.message: More than one room matches {room}. Use its room ID instead; List cleaning plans returns both.

duplicate_room.message: Each room can appear only once. Remove repeated rooms, then try again.

invalid_room_position.message: Choose a position from 1 to {count}, then try again.

plan_preview_changed.message: The plan changed after you previewed it. Preview it again, then run the plan.

room_sequence_preview_changed.message: The rooms changed after you previewed them. Preview them again, then start cleaning.

room_schedule_map_unconfirmed.message: Home Assistant can't match a shared room schedule to a room on the current map. Open Matic Map, check the room, then save the plan again.

plan_name_unusable.message: Home Assistant can't make a plan ID from this name. Add letters or numbers to the name, or set a plan ID.

plan_locked.message: This plan can't be deleted while it is running or while the robot is still confirming a finished room. Stop it or wait, then try again.

room_not_in_plan.message: {room} isn't in {plan}. Check the room ID with List cleaning plans, then try again.

cadence_reset_blocked.message: This room schedule progress is in use by a running plan. Wait for the run to finish, then try again.

invalid_investigator.message: Use a lowercase investigator name of up to 48 characters, such as openclaw.

firmware_evidence_unavailable.message: Home Assistant hasn't checked this robot's firmware yet. Run Advanced: Record firmware snapshot, then try again.

firmware_notification_stale.message: This firmware notification is out of date. Open the Firmware check status sensor for the current report.

plan_disabled.message: This plan is turned off. Turn it on in Matic Map, then try again.

plan_empty.message: This plan has no rooms. Add rooms in Matic Map, then try again.

invalid_plan_command.message: Home Assistant rejected an internal plan command. Start the plan again.

command_superseded.message: A newer command replaced this one before it ran. Send it again if you still want it.

mixed_coverage_needs_plan.message: Rooms with different cleaning modes or vacuum coverage can only be cleaned in order from a saved plan with settings for each room. Save the rooms as a plan, then run it.

coverage_stopped_before_start.message: Cleaning was stopped before it started. Start it again if you still want it.

coverage_start_unconfirmed.message: The robot didn't confirm that the clean started. Check the robot, then try again.

invalid_room_setting.message: A room's cleaning setting can't be used. Check each room's cleaning mode and vacuum coverage, then try again.

firmware_regression.title: {name}: some robot reads are failing
firmware_regression.description: Home Assistant repeatedly could not read {count} items from {name} on firmware {current}, and the saved comparison is from firmware {previous}. A read failure does not prove a firmware problem: open the [device page]({device_url}) and check the Firmware check status sensor to see which items failed.

init.title: Pair {name} again over Bluetooth
init.description: Home Assistant stopped talking to {name}, which no longer matches the robot it was set up with. If it was reset, stay next to it: you will turn on Pairing mode in the Matic app and type a six-digit code, and nothing is saved until the robot accepts it. A replacement robot is added as a new robot. If only the address changed, close this dialog and use Update robot address (Settings > Devices & services > Matic (Unofficial) > the entry's ⋮ menu > Reconfigure). Removing the robot instead erases its plans, room settings, schedule progress, custom areas, history and saved maps.

abort.continue_in_reconfigure: Go to Settings > Devices & services > Matic (Unofficial) > the entry's ⋮ menu > Reconfigure > Robot was reset.

custom_area_map_changed.title: {name}: custom areas need attention
custom_area_map_changed.description: Custom areas to review: {count}. Home Assistant won't clean an area drawn on a different map, with damaged saved data, or that no longer fits the current map: open Matic Map, choose Clean custom area, then confirm or redraw it.

clean_room_sequence.name: Clean room sequence
clean_room_sequence.description: Runs an ordered, unsaved room sequence with cleaning settings for each room.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Up to 100 rooms, in cleaning order. For each room give its name or ID, cleaning mode and vacuum coverage.

return_to_base.name: Return to dock
return_to_base.description: Return to the dock after the final room.

use_room_schedule.name: Use shared room schedule
use_room_schedule.description: Clean what the shared room schedules say is due. Rooms cleaned this way count toward their schedules.

override_room_schedule.name: Override shared room schedule
override_room_schedule.description: Use the settings you chose instead of the schedule's. Cleans that match a schedule still count toward it.

preview_room_sequence.name: Preview room sequence
preview_room_sequence.description: Shows the rooms and order a clean would use right now, including any room schedules, without starting the robot.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Up to 100 rooms, in cleaning order. For each room give its name or ID, cleaning mode and vacuum coverage.

return_to_base.name: Return to dock
return_to_base.description: Include the return-to-dock setting in the preview.

use_room_schedule.name: Use shared room schedule
use_room_schedule.description: Include what the shared room schedules say is due.

override_room_schedule.name: Override shared room schedule
override_room_schedule.description: Use the settings you chose instead of the schedule's; matching cleans still count toward it.

clean_area.name: Clean custom area
clean_area.description: Cleans a named area drawn on the local map. Coordinates stay private inside Home Assistant.

area.name: Custom area
area.description: Exact name or ID of a saved custom area.

cleaning_mode.name: Cleaning mode
cleaning_mode.description: Override the mode saved with this area.

coverage_setting.name: Vacuum coverage
coverage_setting.description: Override the vacuum coverage saved with this area. Does not change mopping; use the robot's Double-pass mopping setting for an extra mop pass.

clean.name: Start cleaning
clean.description: Starts a cleaning run with the selected rooms, mode, coverage, and order.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Up to 100 room names or room IDs, in the order to clean. Omit this field to clean all rooms.

cleaning_mode.name: Cleaning mode
cleaning_mode.description: Cleaning mode for this run. Omit it to use the Default cleaning mode setting.

coverage_setting.name: Vacuum coverage
coverage_setting.description: Vacuum coverage for this run. Omit it to use Default vacuum coverage. Does not change mopping; use the robot's Double-pass mopping setting for an extra mop pass.

ordered.name: Clean in order
ordered.description: Clean rooms in the supplied order.

intelligent_clean.name: Run intelligent rotation
intelligent_clean.description: Cleans the rooms in a plan, starting with the ones that have waited longest, and keeps going until you stop it or every room is done. Rooms that were started but not finished stay due for the next run.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Leave empty to use the default plan. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

clean_entire_plan.name: Run saved order
clean_entire_plan.description: Runs the default or named plan once from top to bottom, using each room's saved settings.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Leave empty to use the default plan. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

run_selected_plan.name: Run plan
run_selected_plan.description: Runs the default or named plan the way it is saved: in saved order, or by rotation starting with the rooms that have waited longest.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Leave empty to use the default plan. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

preview_token.name: Preview ID
preview_token.description: The ID returned by Preview next plan run. Use it to run exactly what you previewed.

preview_plan.name: Preview next plan run
preview_plan.description: Shows which rooms the next plan run would clean without starting the robot or changing history.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Leave empty to use the default plan. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

stop_intelligent_cleaning.name: Stop cleaning
stop_intelligent_cleaning.description: Stops the running plan and sends the robot to its dock. If the plan is set to finish the current room, the robot finishes that room first once enough of it is done. It never starts another room.

include_unmanaged.name: Also stop other cleaning
include_unmanaged.description: If no plan is running, also stop a one-time clean or one started somewhere else (such as the Matic app), and return to the dock. A running plan always follows its own stop setting.

expected_run_id.name: Expected run ID
expected_run_id.description: Optional. A run ID from plan diagnostics. Stop is refused if that run is no longer the one running.

reset_plan_history.name: Reset room cleaning history
reset_plan_history.description: Clears room completion history without deleting plans or room settings.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Leave empty to use the default plan. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

reset_room_cadence.name: Reset room schedule progress
reset_room_cadence.description: Resets room schedule progress (mopping, vacuum rotation, or both) and any 'do it next clean' settings, without changing cleaning history.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: Room ID to reset. Omit this field to reset every scheduled room in the plan.

modes.name: Schedule types
modes.description: Reset mopping, vacuum rotation, or both. Omit this field to reset both.

list_plans.name: List cleaning plans
list_plans.description: Returns saved plans, rooms, room settings, IDs, and the default plan.

save_plan.name: Create or replace cleaning plan
save_plan.description: Creates a plan or replaces an existing plan with the same ID.

plan_id.name: Plan ID
plan_id.description: ID of the plan to replace. Omit it to derive the ID from the plan name.

name.name: Plan name
name.description: The name shown for this plan.

run_behavior.name: Cleaning order
run_behavior.description: Intelligent rotation cleans the rooms that have waited longest first; saved order breaks ties. Saved order cleans every selected room from top to bottom.

rooms.name: Rooms and settings
rooms.description: Rooms in cleaning order, each with its own cleaning mode and vacuum coverage.

return_to_base.name: Return to dock when finished
return_to_base.description: Send the robot to its dock after all selected rooms finish.

finish_current_room.name: Finish the current room when stopping
finish_current_room.description: Allow the active room to finish when its estimated progress meets the threshold. The next room never starts.

finish_current_room_threshold.name: Minimum room progress
finish_current_room_threshold.description: When you stop the plan: below this estimated progress, the robot stops now; at or above it, the robot finishes the room first. The estimate learns from earlier successful runs with the same room settings.

select.name: Use as default plan
select.description: Use this plan when an action does not name one.

start_timeout.name: Start timeout
start_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for each room to start cleaning.

completion_timeout.name: Room completion timeout
completion_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for each room to finish.

delete_plan.name: Delete cleaning plan
delete_plan.description: Deletes one plan by its ID or exact name.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

select_plan.name: Set default cleaning plan
select_plan.description: Sets the plan used when an action, entity, or button does not name one.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

save_plan_room.name: Add or update plan room
save_plan_room.description: Adds one mapped room or updates that room's individual settings.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

room.name: Room and settings
room.description: Mapped room name or room ID, with its cleaning mode and vacuum coverage. If a value matches both an ID and a name, the ID wins.

delete_plan_room.name: Remove room from plan
delete_plan_room.description: Removes one mapped room and its settings from a plan.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

room.name: Room
room.description: Mapped room name or room ID. If a value matches both an ID and a name, the ID wins.

move_plan_room.name: Move room in plan
move_plan_room.description: Changes one mapped room's saved position.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or ID. Find IDs with List cleaning plans.

room.name: Room
room.description: Mapped room name or room ID. If a value matches both an ID and a name, the ID wins.

new_position.name: New position
new_position.description: New position in the room list, where 1 is the top.

inspect_hermes_endpoint.name: Advanced: Inspect robot data
inspect_hermes_endpoint.description: Reads the size and a checksum of one item in the robot's local data. Its contents are never stored or shown. Items that hold credentials are blocked.

endpoint.name: Data item
endpoint.description: The property or collection in the robot's local data to inspect.

firmware_snapshot.name: Advanced: Record firmware snapshot
firmware_snapshot.description: Reads every known non-credential item in the robot's local data, saves a record without the data itself, and reports what is newly available, missing, or changed since the last snapshot.

firmware_investigator.name: Advanced: Choose firmware investigator
firmware_investigator.description: Home Assistant assigns the connected agent that researches firmware reports, and robot controls are unchanged. Switching agents ends any research already claimed and keeps the evidence, and only administrators can call this action.

provider.name: Investigator
provider.description: A lowercase name such as openclaw, dot, or bot. Use manual to stop automatic claims. The named agent must be connected separately.

firmware_notification.name: Advanced: Update firmware notification
firmware_notification.description: Home Assistant records that the current firmware report was acknowledged or that its notification was delivered, or asks for another read-only check. The firmware alerts blueprint uses it.

report_id.name: Report ID
report_id.description: The current report ID from the Firmware check status sensor.

revision.name: Report version
revision.description: The version of the current report, as shown by the Firmware check status sensor.

action.name: Action
action.description: Acknowledge, mark as delivered, or check again.
